title: The Sick Well
text: The town well has turned brackish, green scum on the bucket, and the children who drank from it dream of drowning and wake coughing up river weed. The physicians traced the sickness to a nest beyond the Gate, in the Drowned Marches. It must be cleansed at the source.

options.label: Seal the well until it is cleansed, whatever the water costs meanwhile.

outcomes.text: Water comes by cart from the river, dear and slow, and the children stop dreaming.

options.label: Boil it and keep drinking. The city cannot go without water.

outcomes.text: It tastes of iron, but it holds.
The dreams spread, house to house, and more children wake coughing weed.

options.label: Have it blessed at the Shrine, and let the city see you try.

outcomes.text: The priests sing over it every night. It helps the singers, at least, and the city sees them try.
